reason: Fresh independent r5 QA reproduced one bootstrap trust-boundary P0 and one pre-freeze target-access P1 before any scientific operation. This amendment fixes only those execution boundaries and exact authorization schema enforcement.

P0_worker_bootstrap_outside_snapshot.observed: r5 launched live Path(__file__) with python -B, so live-runner replacement and PYTHONPATH/sitecustomize/.pth execution could precede snapshot verification.
required_v6: The exact worker bootstrap bytes are copied into and pinned by the private snapshot before launch.
The parent retains held source authorities until the worker has authenticated its snapshot.
The worker starts with Python isolated mode and bytecode disabled; its first executable project bytes are the pinned snapshot bootstrap.
No PYTHONPATH, user-site, sitecustomize, usercustomize, or .pth processing may precede authorization and exact-tree verification.
Any required third-party import path is derived only after authentication from a sealed explicit inventory without .pth processing.
The exact snapshot tree, directories, links, bytecode ban, and file hashes are verified immediately before and after all project-module imports and before claim.

P1_eager_train_target_parse.observed: r5 parsed the full train.csv and computed a label-derived left-censor audit before the all-fold outer prediction freeze.
required_v6: Pre-freeze readiness may materialize only an explicitly enumerated target-free training view.
Historical labels needed for strictly earlier anchor and inner fits are separated from every registered outer-evaluation key and protected by the fixed cutoffs and purge.
Outer-period label and anomaly_type remain opaque held bytes until record_outer_freeze succeeds after all 72 fits and 21 materializations.
Every label-derived outer audit, including left-censor counts and Round-B metrics, runs only after freeze.
Reader-level sentinels fail on any pre-freeze conversion, indexing, merge, serialization, or aggregate involving protected outer target columns.

P2_authorization_schema_exactness.observed: r5 authenticated raw bytes and core values but did not require the exact schema_version value or exact nested key/type membership in both parent and worker.
required_v6: Parent and worker enforce one exact schema_version.
Parent and worker enforce exact top-level and nested key membership and primitive types for seal and QA receipts.
Wrong version, extra nested fields, missing fields, and wrong types fail before repository/static read, snapshot creation, project import, or claim.

mandatory_negative_tests: Malicious PYTHONPATH/sitecustomize marker is not created and execution fails closed.
A live-runner swap after parent verification executes zero substituted bytes.
A pre-import snapshot extra .py, .pyc, link, or transitive-source swap fails before claim.
Any pre-freeze protected train label/anomaly_type access triggers a sentinel before value conversion.
Wrong authorization version, unknown nested capability, missing field, extra field, and wrong type all fail before static read or import.
fail_closed_if: any scientific or numerical choice differs from the pinned v1/v2/v3 authorities
the r5 independent QA report does not preserve the reproduced P0/P1 findings
the worker can execute any unpinned bootstrap or environment startup hook
any protected outer target is parsed before the all-fold prediction freeze
authorization schema is not exact in parent and worker
any official test/sample/submission/candidate path is accessed
any prior v6 claim, fit, materialization, score, candidate, or upload exists
